_comment: Unit-level move-order validation against block terrain. One 60-man Infantry block, 3 files x 20 ranks (about 36 x 342 wu), faces north at (1080, 330) just west of the default hill rect (1150,380)-(1400,580); its rear ranks run past the hill's top edge. It is selected at tick 10, then side-stepped east with six Right nudges at ticks 30, 120, 210, 300, 390 and 480. Each nudge steps 30 wu from wherever the block stands when it is issued. The first two are clear and go the full distance. The third (tick 210, from about x 1123) would put the right file's rear ranks inside the hill, so the order is pulled back to the nearest point where the footprint is clear (centre about x 1127). For the last three the block is already parked at the edge, so each is pulled back to within SEARCH_TOLERANCE (1 wu) of where it stands and the block stays put. With the clamp reverted, the same script leaves 7 men inside the hill at tick 296 and 21 at ticks 392, 480 and 600. drill mode: no enemy is needed. `state` samples every 8 ticks from 8 to 600; `expect` pins soldiers_in_block_terrain at 0 across every nudge window and at the end.
